zh: 只需要知道每个值出现了多少次，出现次数最多的那个值的次数就是答案。
用哈希表统计频率：每读到一个元素，就给它对应的计数加一。
建立值到次数的映射；遍历数组，counts[v] 加一并随时更新最大计数；输出最大计数。
en: All you need is how many times each value occurs; the count of the most frequent value is the answer.
Count frequencies with a hash map: every element adds one to its own counter.
Build a map from value to count; for each element increment counts[v] and keep the running maximum; print that maximum.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Accumulate the number of occurrences of each value in a hash map and take the largest count.

## Correctness

Each element adds exactly one to its own counter, so in the end every counter equals the true frequency of its value, and the largest counter is the required result.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n), space O(n).
